summary: Enrolled students (including those expected to return from leave) who have completed at least two regular semesters and earned at least 33 credits may apply for a multiple major (minor, double major, interdisciplinary major, linked major or student-designed major) for Spring 2027. Applications are made by the student on the portal (mysnu.ac.kr) from 12 to 16 October 2026 for double and interdisciplinary majors, and from 26 to 30 October 2026 for minors, linked majors and student-designed majors. Students from other departments applying for a double major or minor in Electrical and Computer Engineering must also email a transcript and a study plan by 18:00 on 16 October (double major) or 30 October (minor).
applies_to: Optional (by application). Open to enrolled students, including students expected to return from leave, who have completed at least two regular semesters and earned at least 33 credits, and who will be enrolled on 1 March 2027. Students from other departments applying for a double major or minor in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기정보공학부) must also have a GPA of at least 2.7 and have completed at least two of its prerequisite courses. Applicants for a student-designed major must have an overall GPA of at least 3.3.

conditions: All applicants must have completed at least two regular semesters and earned at least 33 credits; students expected to return from leave may apply.
Selection is for students enrolled on 1 March 2027, so Spring 2027 results cannot count toward graduation on 24 February 2027.
Students from other departments applying for a double major or minor in Electrical and Computer Engineering need a GPA of at least 2.7.
They must also have completed at least two of: Physics 2 (or Honors Physics 2), Engineering Mathematics 1, Engineering Mathematics 2, and Computer Concepts and Practice.
The transcript must be issued through the certificate issuance service; a cumulative grade report is not accepted.
If the transcript and study plan are not submitted within the period, the student is treated as not wishing to apply.
A student-designed major requires an overall GPA of at least 3.3 and is approved only after the paper application form and related documents are submitted following the online application.
If you are selected for a double major or minor in a major you are already taking as a multiple major, the existing multiple major is cancelled automatically.
You cannot be selected for both a double major and a minor in the same major in the same academic year and semester; if not selected for the double major, you may apply for the minor.
You may apply for at most 3 multiple majors per semester and take at most 6 in total.
Based on the application date: 6 or more multiple majors already taken means you cannot apply; 5 means 1 application; 4 means 2; 3 or fewer means 3.
The eligibility and limit changes are explained in an attachment, which was not read.
steps: All applicants: Read the attached documents on the changes to eligibility and the limit on the number of multiple majors (attachments were not read for this translation).

All applicants: Apply yourself within your period on the portal (mysnu.ac.kr) under Academic Information > Change of Academic Status > Application > Major/Program Application (학사정보 > 학적변동 > 신청 > 전공/과정 신청).

Student-designed major applicants: After applying online, submit the paper application form and related documents for approval (the notice does not say where; see the attached guides, which were not read).

Electrical and Computer Engineering double major (other departments): By 18:00 on 16 October 2026, email one transcript (issued via certificate issuance, showing the prerequisite courses) and one study plan (attached form, 수학계획서) to the address in the original notice, labelling each file with your student ID and name.
Electrical and Computer Engineering double major (other departments): Check your result, to be announced by 23 October 2026.

Electrical and Computer Engineering minor (other departments): By 18:00 on 30 October 2026, email one transcript (issued via certificate issuance, showing the prerequisite courses) and one study plan (attached form, 수학계획서) to the address in the original notice, labelling each file with your student ID and name.
Electrical and Computer Engineering minor (other departments): Check your result, to be announced by 20 November 2026.
translation:
Spring 2027 Multiple-Major Selection Plan

We announce the selection plan for multiple majors (minor, double major, interdisciplinary major, linked major and student-designed major) for Spring 2027. Eligible students should apply within the deadline.
In addition, eligibility and the number of multiple majors each person may take are limited, so you must check the changes in the attachment.

A. Eligibility
○ Common requirement: enrolled students (including students expected to return from leave) who have completed at least two regular semesters and earned at least 33 credits
○ Students from other departments applying for a multiple major (double major, minor) in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기정보공학부): GPA of at least 2.7
○ Student-designed major: overall GPA of at least 3.3

B. Application period
○ Double and interdisciplinary majors: Monday 12 October 2026, 09:00 to Friday 16 October 2026, 18:00
○ Minors, linked majors and student-designed majors: Monday 26 October 2026, 09:00 to Friday 30 October 2026, 18:00

C. How to apply
○ Students apply themselves on the portal (mysnu.ac.kr) > Academic Information (학사정보) > Change of Academic Status (학적변동) > Application (신청) > Major/Program Application (전공/과정 신청)
(However, a student-designed major is approved after the online application and submission of a paper application form and related documents.)

D. Students from other departments applying for a multiple major (double major, minor) in Electrical and Computer Engineering
○ Double major documents: one transcript (a transcript issued through certificate issuance, not a cumulative grade report) and one study plan (submit by email to the address in the original notice by Friday 16 October, 18:00)
○ Double major selection results: to be announced by Friday 23 October 2026
○ Minor documents: one transcript (a transcript issued through certificate issuance, not a cumulative grade report) and one study plan (submit by email to the address in the original notice by Friday 30 October, 18:00)
○ Minor selection results: to be announced by Friday 20 November 2026
* State your student ID and name when submitting documents, e.g. Transcript: 2025-** [Name] transcript; Study plan: 2025-** [Name]
※ If the documents (transcript, study plan) are not submitted within the submission period, you will be considered as not wishing to apply.
※ Selected students' multiple majors will be entered in academic records: Friday 15 January 2027 (planned)
※ Spring 2027 multiple majors are selected for students enrolled on 1 March 2027, so Spring 2027 selection results cannot be applied to the graduation of 24 February 2027 (후기 graduation).

E. Criteria for students of other majors applying for a multiple major (double major, minor) in Electrical and Computer Engineering
Eligibility: GPA of at least 2.7, and completion of at least two of the Electrical and Computer Engineering prerequisite courses (Physics 2 (or Honors Physics 2), Engineering Mathematics 1, Engineering Mathematics 2, Computer Concepts and Practice)
Required documents:
- Transcript (showing the Electrical and Computer Engineering prerequisite courses)
- Study plan (수학계획서): attached form

F. Important notes
○ If you are selected for a double major or minor in the same major you are already taking as a multiple major, the multiple major you are already taking is automatically cancelled.
○ You cannot be selected for both a double major and a minor in the same major in the same academic year/semester. If you are not selected for the double major, you may apply for the minor.
○ Limit on the number of multiple majors per person
- Maximum number of multiple majors you may apply for per semester: 3
- Number of multiple majors one person may take: 6
- Number of applications allowed depending on your situation:
# Taking 6 or more multiple majors as of the application date: cannot apply
# Taking 5 multiple majors as of the application date: may apply for 1
# Taking 4 multiple majors as of the application date: may apply for 2
# Taking 3 or fewer multiple majors as of the application date: may apply for 3

* Enquiries: the department office (contact details are in the original notice).
